subject: QBR prep: Zephyr Systems — health snapshot & items for exec attention
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@zephyrsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@zephyrsys.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zephyr QBR — request & pre-read

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the continued partnership. We're scheduling our QBR for Aug 20 and I wanted to send an early note on three items we'd like on the agenda:

1) Recent production latency spikes on our inference-heavy endpoints (we're seeing 95th p95 jump during morning traffic).
2) Contract renewal conversation and price alignment for committed capacity starting Oct 1.
3) Security control question: can we get an export of token-level access logs for audit?

Can your team share a short health snapshot + any risk items you want escalated to your leadership before the meeting? If possible, a 1-slide summary and a short risk register would be helpful.

--
Emma Li
VP, Product
Zephyr Systems
emma@zephyrsys.com

P.S. Contracts is CC'd — they will coordinate the renewal timeline on their side.

- I'll assemble a 1-slide health snapshot and a short risk register by EOD Aug 11.
- Lauren, can you prioritize the product/infra action items? Marissa, please include contract and renewal timeline notes; Aditya, can you pull token-access/export feasibility and ETA?

I'll push a draft to our shared Drive and send you the deck + the risk register. If you have any specific logs or spans you want included, flag them here and we'll pull.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zephyr QBR — request & pre-read

Karthik / team — draft health snapshot attached (see drive link). High-level notes here:

- Current utilization: steady at 72% avg GPU pool for Zephyr dedicated cluster; morning 95th latency spikes align with a specific traffic pattern that increases seq length (chat transcripts with long context).
- Root cause hypothesis: KV cache miss rate increases with long-tail seq lengths + smaller-than-ideal batch windows during peak ingress (we observed 30% more micro-batches).

Priority action items (proposed):
1) Short-term (<=2 weeks): increase batching window by 50ms during morning window + enable prefix KV caching for the affected route (low-risk runtime config).
2) Mid-term (4-8 weeks): quantify benefit from activating quantized model variant for non-customer-facing inference jobs and schedule a canary for Oct 1.
3) Ask for exec attention: request approval for a short burst capacity commit for Sept-Nov to keep p95 within SLO during product launch testing.

Attachments referenced: zephyr_renewal_risk_register.xlsx (draft with prioritization matrix).

--
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Looping in contracting context and commercial notes:

- Renewal window: contract up for renewal Oct 31. Current ARR ~$1.2M, renewal target is +12% with a 12-month committed capacity.
- Risk items: if we cannot give a credible plan to address p95, Zephyr product could push renewal to a shorter term and ask for a performance credit. Need to avoid high-friction negotiation.
- Ask: propose a limited-time incentive (1 month free burst in Sept) in exchange for a signed 12-month commit by Sept 15. If leadership approves, we'll include in the QBR offer.

Marissa's proposed timeline:
- Aug 11: deliver health snapshot + risk register to Emma.
- Aug 13–17: internal exec primer (we should get sign-off on the incentive).
- Aug 20: QBR with Zephyr.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive

marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@zephyrsys.com>, contracts@zephyrsys.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Zephyr QBR — request & pre-read — EXEC ATTENTION ITEMS

Team — forwarding final materials and the distilled exec asks we need approval on before Aug 15: 

1) Approve a one-month burst credit in Sept for Zephyr (estimated cost to Redwood: ~$18k) conditioned on a signed 12-month committed capacity (target +12% ARR). This is a commercial lever to trade for term.
2) Approve temporary modification to autoscaler policy for Zephyr cluster (increase burst capacity ceiling Sept–Nov) to prevent p95 regressions during their product tests.
3) Approve priority run for token-level access export (ad-hoc audit) — security team to confirm data scope; timeline target Aug 18.

Attachments: zephyr_qbr_prep_deck_v1.pdf (slides), zephyr_renewal_risk_register.xlsx (risk scoring + mitigation tracker). Drive link: https://redwood-sharing.company/drive/zephyr-qbr-draft

Quick summary for execs: Zephyr is strategic (expansion next year) but sensitive to latency. If we give a credible mitigation plan and a short commercial incentive, we increase the chance of a 12-month commit. If we fail to move quickly, renewal could shift to a shorter term and weaken pricing.

Please reply with APPROVE / REJECT / NEEDS MORE INFO by EOD Aug 14 so we can finalize the QBR offer.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
